MULTIPLAYEREXPANDED-COUNTERPUNCH_POWER.d: If an attack is completely blocked without breaking Block, its player receives Countered.
MULTIPLAYEREXPANDED-SANDPIT_MP_POWER.des: Escape before the countdown expires. Remaining countdown: {Amount}.
MULTIPLAYEREXPANDED-TEAM_WITHERING_PRESE: After 6 cards are played across the party, give a Wither to the player who played the last card. Remaining cards: {Amount}.
MULTIPLAYEREXPANDED-PARANOIA_POWER.title: Paranoia
MULTIPLAYEREXPANDED-PARANOIA_POWER.descr: Parafright deals 50% more attack damage to a player who attacked this enemy this turn.
MULTIPLAYEREXPANDED-FROZEN_IN_PLACE_POWE: Cannot move to the other column until this effect expires.
MULTIPLAYEREXPANDED-COUNTERED_POWER.desc: Takes 50% more attack damage from an enemy with Counterpunch this turn.
MULTIPLAYEREXPANDED-TAKING_TURNS_POWER.d: Living players must alternate manually played cards. Automatically played cards are unaffected.
MULTIPLAYEREXPANDED-VITAL_SPARK_MP_POWER: Skills gain Tainted. Playing them gives Tainted to their player. The player or players with the most Tainted gain 1 Energy next turn.
MULTIPLAYEREXPANDED-MARTYRDOM_POWER.desc: Your cards cannot give you Block.
MULTIPLAYEREXPANDED-HOARDING_POWER.title: Hoarding
MULTIPLAYEREXPANDED-HOARDING_POWER.descr: You cannot manually play a card when your hand contains two or fewer cards.
MULTIPLAYEREXPANDED-COLD_FEET_POWER.desc: After another player acts, your next manually played card must match that card's type. You cannot play twice consecutively.
MULTIPLAYEREXPANDED-HAZE_POWER.title: Haze
MULTIPLAYEREXPANDED-HAZE_POWER.descripti: At the end of your turn, add {Amount} Dazed to your draw pile.
MULTIPLAYEREXPANDED-INNER_WORLD_POWER.de: You cannot play cards that target another player.
MULTIPLAYEREXPANDED-FRUSTRATION_POWER.de: At the end of your turn, each living player takes {Amount} damage for each card remaining in your hand.
MULTIPLAYEREXPANDED-RIGHT_COLUMN_ENEMY_P: This enemy attacks living players facing its column. If none remain, it attacks the surviving party.
MULTIPLAYEREXPANDED-COLUMN_POWER.title: Facing
MULTIPLAYEREXPANDED-COLUMN_POWER.descrip: Target an enemy with a card or potion to face its column. If that column is full, its longest-standing occupant swaps columns.
MULTIPLAYEREXPANDED-LEFT_COLUMN_ENEMY_PO: This enemy attacks living players facing its column. If none remain, it attacks the surviving party.
MULTIPLAYEREXPANDED-DECAYED_POWER.title: Decayed
MULTIPLAYEREXPANDED-DECAYED_POWER.descri: At the start of the enemy turn, take {Amount} damage, then remove this effect.
MULTIPLAYEREXPANDED-GLUTTONY_HEX_POWER.d: The party is haunted by {Holder}'s Gluttony. Your Hexed cards gain Ethereal while this effect remains.
MULTIPLAYEREXPANDED-BECKONED_POWER.title: Beckoned
MULTIPLAYEREXPANDED-BECKONED_POWER.descr: Lose {Amount} HP at the start of the enemy turn.
MULTIPLAYEREXPANDED-BURNING_POWER.title: Burning
MULTIPLAYEREXPANDED-BURNING_POWER.descri: Take {Damage} damage at the start of the enemy turn, equal to the combined Burn damage in all living players' hands at turn end.
MULTIPLAYEREXPANDED-INFECTED_POWER.title: Infected
MULTIPLAYEREXPANDED-INFECTED_POWER.descr: Take {Amount} damage at the start of the enemy turn. If any damage is unblocked, add {Dazes} Dazed to every living player's discard pile.
MULTIPLAYEREXPANDED-TAG_TEAM_MP_POWER.de: The next eligible manual Attack by a player other than {Teammate} is copied and automatically played by {Teammate} against this enemy.
MULTIPLAYEREXPANDED-TOXIFIED_POWER.title: Toxified
MULTIPLAYEREXPANDED-TOXIFIED_POWER.descr: Take {Amount} damage at the start of the enemy turn.
MULTIPLAYEREXPANDED-WITHERED_POWER.title: Withered
MULTIPLAYEREXPANDED-WITHERED_POWER.descr: Take {Amount} damage at the start of the enemy turn.
MULTIPLAYEREXPANDED-TRACKING_MP_POWER.de: Your and your pets' powered attacks deal {Amount}% more damage to Weak monsters.
MULTIPLAYEREXPANDED-PLOT_POWER.title: Plot
MULTIPLAYEREXPANDED-PLOT_POWER.descripti: Before your next hand draw, draw up to {Amount} colorless cards from your draw pile, then remove this power.
MULTIPLAYEREXPANDED-THE_BALL_POWER.title: The Ball
MULTIPLAYEREXPANDED-THE_BALL_POWER.descr: Deal {Amount} unblocked damage to this holder with player or pet damage to return The Ball to a living player. The threshold resets at the start of the player turn.
The Ball begins tracking this enemy at the start of the next player turn. Removing this power returns The Ball.
MULTIPLAYEREXPANDED-IMMORTAL_POWER.title: Immortal
MULTIPLAYEREXPANDED-IMMORTAL_POWER.descr: The next time this creature would die, heal it for {Amount}% of maximum HP instead, then remove this power.
MULTIPLAYEREXPANDED-IMPROVEMENTS_POWER.d: At the end of combat, permanently upgrade {Amount} random upgradable card(s) in this player's deck. Persists through death.
